page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (printed as f, e.g. "fequitur", "fuiffet", "fpirituali"). Printed "Obferva", "Antichriftus" etc. normalised accordingly. "extium" is doubtful; it may be a printing error for "exitium", so it is marked [?]. The underlined Q in "Quod" and "Quamobrem" is a decorative initial, not a marked word. The page ends mid-word "sub-" and the text continues on the next page, so there is no catchword.
